prompt: You just received a noisy application log bundle from a staging server. Please sanitize all logs in the current directory so they are safe to share with the security team. Keep the overall structure of each file, but remove any passwords, API tokens, bearer tokens, session IDs, and obvious secrets. Write the cleaned result to new files with the same base names plus a `.sanitized` suffix. Preserve non-sensitive text, timestamps, and log formatting as much as possible. Also produce a short `summary.txt` that lists which files were sanitized and how many sensitive-looking items were removed from each one.
